structure.title: Page structure
structure.help: Click a part of the page on the right, or pick it here.

subtitles.photos: Shown at the top of your restaurant page as a slideshow.
subtitles.details: Shown under the photos and at the bottom of your page.
subtitles.notes: Short messages under your restaurant name.
subtitles.menus: Each menu is a tab on your menu page. Drag to change the order.
subtitles.hours: Used for the Open / Closed status and the weekly schedule.
subtitles.brand: Used for buttons, tabs and highlights on every page.
subtitles.menu: A tab on your menu page.

preview.title: Preview of your public page
preview.hidden: Guests don't see it, so it isn't in the preview

brand.readable_text: Text on tinted backgrounds has {ratio} : 1 contrast (needs 4.5).
brand.hard_to_read_text: Text on tinted backgrounds has {ratio} : 1 contrast, it needs 4.5. Pick a darker text color.
brand.fine_tune_help: Editing a value switches to Custom
brand.near_allergens: Close to the orange used for allergens, so allergen labels stand out a little less on the menu.

reorder.label: Move {name}: drag, or use the arrow keys
reorder.hint: Drag, or use the arrow keys

details.name: Restaurant name
details.type_help: Pick from the list; guests see it in their language.
details.phone_help: Same in all languages. Guests can copy it with one tap.

notes.label: Notes
notes.edit_help: Enter to finish · Esc to cancel
notes.info: Keep notes to one short sentence. Hidden notes stay here for later but guests don't see them.

photos.formats: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. Landscape photos work best.
photos.uploading: No photos uploading | {count} photo uploading | {count} photos uploading
photos.wrong_type: {name} isn't a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
photos.info: The first visible photo is the cover and is shown when your link is shared. {hide} keeps a photo here without showing it to guests, so you can bring it back later.
photos.label: Photos

hours.time_zone_help: Open / Closed on your page is calculated in this time zone.
hours.after_midnight: Closing after midnight? Enter e.g. 02:00 and it counts toward the same evening.
hours.same_time: Closing time has to differ from the opening time.
hours.overlap: Hours of a day can't overlap.
hours.special_days_help: Holidays and short days override the weekly hours.
hours.end_before_start: The last day can't be before the first one.
hours.close_temporarily_help: For renovation or vacation. Your page shows Closed with your reason until the date you pick.

menus.last_visible_message: Without it, your menu page has no menus until you show one again.
menus.info: {hide} takes a menu off your site for now. {archive} moves it out of this list with all its dishes, ready to restore. {delete} is permanent and only available for archived menus (⋯ menu).

menu.name: Menu name
menu.description_help: Optional. Shown under the menu's name.
menu.hidden: Hidden from guests. It stays here, but it isn't on your page.

category.name: Category name
category.description_help: Optional. Shown under the category title.
category.hidden: Hidden from guests with its dishes. It stays here, but it isn't on your page.
category.info: To move a dish to another category, open it and pick Move to category in its ⋯ menu.

dish.shown_help: Turn off to hide it for a while, e.g. when it's sold out.
dish.name: Name
dish.badge_help: Optional. Shown as a banner above the dish.
dish.sizes_help: One size shows as text on the menu. With two or more, guests switch between them and the price, time and calories update.
dish.size_number: The size is a number, e.g. 300.
dish.tags_help: Shown on the menu in your brand color. Guests can filter by them in search.

tag_hints.nutrition: low and high exclude each other

dish.allergens_help: Shown in orange on the menu and on the dish page. Mark every allergen the dish contains: guests rely on this list.
dish.on_its_page: The preview shows this dish's page. Click a block there to jump to its field.
dish.photos_help: Up to 3 photos. The first visible one is shown in the menu list; guests can swipe through all of them on the dish page.
dish.sorted: Sorted by price, from lowest to highest
dish.whole_number: Time and calories are whole numbers, e.g. 15.
dish.last_shown: Guests see at least one size
dish.size_hidden: Hidden from guests. It stays here for later.

actions.delete_with: This deletes {contents} too. It can't be undone.
actions.duplicated: “{name}” copied. The copy is hidden till you show it.

toolbar.select_help: Click a part of the page to edit it
toolbar.browse_help: Use the page like a guest. Hold Alt to browse for a moment.

save.count: No unsaved items | {count} item unsaved | {count} items unsaved
save.discard_title: Discard the unsaved item? | Discard {count} unsaved items?
save.discard_message: Your changes are lost. It can't be undone.
save.not_saved: {count} item wasn't saved. Fix it and save again. | {count} items weren't saved. Fix them and save again.
save.wait_uploads: Wait till the photos are uploaded

unsaved.title: No unsaved items | {count} unsaved item | {count} unsaved items
unsaved.kept: Kept until you save or discard
unsaved.name: Name
unsaved.days_hours: Hours of {count} day | Hours of {count} days
unsaved.big_update: Big update? Put these changes into a scheduled version and pick when they go live.

planned.dish_one: 1 scheduled change for this dish: {what} on {date}.
planned.dish_many: {count} scheduled changes for this dish, the first on {date}.
planned.category_one: 1 scheduled change for this category: {what} on {date}.
planned.category_many: {count} scheduled changes for this category, the first on {date}.
planned.menu_one: 1 scheduled change for this menu: {what} on {date}.
planned.menu_many: {count} scheduled changes for this menu, the first on {date}.

schedule.title: Schedule for later
schedule.help: Guests keep seeing the current version until then.
schedule.more: and {count} more item | and {count} more items
schedule.staying: {names} can't be scheduled and stays unsaved. | {names} can't be scheduled and stay unsaved.
schedule.own_help: Its own date and time, set below
schedule.in_past: Pick a time in the future.
schedule.nothing: None of the unsaved changes can be scheduled.
